ensemble_rule: arithmetic mean logits, no threshold tuning
initialization: All arms start fresh: cached ImageNet encoder plus seed-dependent random decoder; no checkpoint warmstart
primary_checkpoints: Fixed final epoch for each arm and ensemble; selected checkpoints diagnostic only, no pair search

budget.equal_total_comparison: Dual 2x15 versus fresh single30: equal total optimizer steps and training-image exposures; each arm has its own frozen cosine horizon; not exact hardware-time matching
budget.same_per_network_comparison: Dual 2x15 versus single15: ensemble uses twice the training updates and parameters
budget.training_timing: Wall time includes initialization, training, epoch validation and checkpoint I/O; ensemble members trained sequentially; record CUDA peak allocation per arm

performance.input: cached native BGR images; OpenCV demo preprocessing; excludes decoding, rendering and geometry

constraints: kidney_stones_fiber_v1 supervised190 only; stone_new banned; 800 reserved images unused; video_1/video_2 validation only; no pseudo labels or mutual learning
stop_policy: Existing frozen collapse checks; no automatic extension; aborted arms cannot be treated as equal-budget results
